title: JustAI raised $1.7M from Peak XV and Y-Combinator
summary: Here's a shout out to our early believers - people who have been pivotal in our journey at just words. They gave us the extra nudge when the chips were down.
body_markdown:
We raised our seed round led by[Peak XV Partners](https://www.linkedin.com/company/peakxvpartners/) ,[Y Combinator](https://www.linkedin.com/company/y-combinator/) ,[Lobster Capital](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lobstercapital/) ,[Cloud Capital, an affiliate of CloudHQ LLC](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cldcap/) . A shout out to our early believers - people who have been pivotal in our journey at[just words](https://www.linkedin.com/company/justwordsai/) . They gave us the extra nudge when the chips were down.
